films.title: The Odyssey
films.description: Konchalovsky's miniseries keeps Elpenor's fall and underworld plea — the youngest crewman who begs Odysseus for burial rites.

films.title: L'Odissea
films.description: Rossi's Italian-Yugoslav Odyssey gives Elpenor his Circean roof and Nekyia voice among the shades.

popCulture.title: Odyssey
popCulture.creator: Homer
popCulture.description: Books 10–12: the drunken fall from Circe's roof, the unburied shade who speaks first in Hades, and the cairn Odysseus raises on Aeaea.

popCulture.title: Elpenor
popCulture.creator: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe
popCulture.description: Goethe's unfinished tragedy borrows the Homeric name for a classical fragment — Elpenor as German neoclassical experiment.
